verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents auto-reply texts, scheduled messages, missed-call text-back, or after-hours SMS replies. The closest items are Sona AI call answering (an adjacent feature), on-demand one-off texting through MCP (not scheduled or automatic), and viewing missed-call info (not texting back), so none of them earn credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can send auto-replies and scheduled texts, like missed-call text-back and after-hours replies
